# kavynUI - full component index

> 134 components in 15 families. Copy any file into a React + Tailwind project and ship it. Source and docs: https://kavynui.com

- [Edge Dashboard](https://kavynui.com/components/edge-dashboard) (blocks): Live analytics dashboard with stat tiles, request map and top countries Use case: Admin overview.
- [Product Hero](https://kavynui.com/components/product-hero) (blocks): Headline and actions beside an app window running a deploy Use case: SaaS landing page.
- [Feature Bento](https://kavynui.com/components/feature-bento) (blocks): Four feature tiles, each with its own small live demo Use case: Features section.
- [Proof Wall](https://kavynui.com/components/proof-wall) (blocks): Logo marquee with a rotating customer quote Use case: Social proof.
- [Globe CTA](https://kavynui.com/components/globe-cta) (blocks): Closing call to action next to a live dotted globe Use case: Bottom-of-page CTA.
- [Changelog Feed](https://kavynui.com/components/changelog-feed) (blocks): Release timeline whose entries expand in place Use case: Changelog page.
- [Sign-in Card](https://kavynui.com/components/sign-in-card) (blocks): Magic-link sign-in with validation, shake and sent state Use case: Auth screen.
- [FAQ Accordion](https://kavynui.com/components/faq-accordion) (blocks): One-open-at-a-time questions with a plus that becomes a minus Use case: Pricing page FAQ.
- [Status Board](https://kavynui.com/components/status-board) (blocks): Overall system state plus 90-day history per service Use case: Public status page.
- [Wordmark Footer](https://kavynui.com/components/wordmark-footer) (blocks): Link columns over a giant wordmark that rises in Use case: Site footer.
- [Traffic Map](https://kavynui.com/components/traffic-map) (data): Dotted world map with live request arcs between edge cities Use case: Network overview.
- [Edge Globe](https://kavynui.com/components/edge-globe) (data): Rotating globe of real land dots with arcs. Drag to spin Use case: Global presence.
- [Uptime Bars](https://kavynui.com/components/uptime-bars) (data): 90-day status bars that rise in, with a per-day tooltip Use case: Service health.
- [Latency Stream](https://kavynui.com/components/latency-stream) (data): Live latency line streaming from the right with an average Use case: Performance widget.
- [Threat Feed](https://kavynui.com/components/threat-feed) (data): Security events slide into a live list; hover pauses it Use case: Firewall activity.
- [Region Bars](https://kavynui.com/components/region-bars) (data): Top countries by traffic, re-ranking as shares shift Use case: Traffic breakdown.
- [Request Heatmap](https://kavynui.com/components/request-heatmap) (data): Hour by weekday grid that fills on a diagonal wave Use case: Usage patterns.
- [Cache Ring](https://kavynui.com/components/cache-ring) (data): Donut ring and number spring to each new ratio Use case: Cache hit ratio.
- [Liquid Button](https://kavynui.com/components/liquid-button) (actions): Gooey blobs merge and split on hover Use case: Primary CTA.
- [Ember Button](https://kavynui.com/components/ember-button) (actions): Edge heat-shimmer builds as the cursor gets closer Use case: Checkout "Pay now".
- [Magnet Pill](https://kavynui.com/components/magnet-pill) (actions): Label drifts toward the cursor, pill stretches back Use case: Newsletter signup.
- [Hold to Confirm](https://kavynui.com/components/hold-to-confirm) (actions): Ring fills while held, then snaps to a check Use case: Delete account.
- [Ink Bleed Button](https://kavynui.com/components/ink-bleed-button) (actions): Fill floods in from the exact entry point Use case: Pricing CTA.
- [Split Flap Button](https://kavynui.com/components/split-flap-button) (actions): Label flips like a departures board on state change Use case: Seat booking.
- [Stamp Button](https://kavynui.com/components/stamp-button) (actions): Squash-and-press that leaves an embossed seal Use case: Approve invoice.
- [Orbit Button](https://kavynui.com/components/orbit-button) (actions): A spark orbits the border while work runs Use case: AI "Generate".
- [Fuse Button](https://kavynui.com/components/fuse-button) (actions): A spark burns along the border as a countdown Use case: Undo send.
- [Shutter Button](https://kavynui.com/components/shutter-button) (actions): Aperture blades open to reveal the icon Use case: Photo upload.
- [Pixel Melt Button](https://kavynui.com/components/pixel-melt-button) (actions): Label melts into pixels on success Use case: Form submit.
- [Text Scramble](https://kavynui.com/components/text-scramble) (type): Letters decode from noise, left to right, again on hover Use case: Dev-tool headline.
- [Shimmer Text](https://kavynui.com/components/shimmer-text) (type): A light band sweeps across muted text Use case: "Thinking" label.
- [Flip Words](https://kavynui.com/components/flip-words) (type): The last word rolls to the next, letter by letter Use case: Hero tagline.
- [Odometer Figures](https://kavynui.com/components/odometer-figures) (type): Digits roll with a mechanical overshoot Use case: Revenue dashboard.
- [Ink Write](https://kavynui.com/components/ink-write) (type): Strokes draw in along a handwritten path Use case: Onboarding welcome.
